units.translation: Examples of this common usage, arranged according to the order of the plays, are these, sometimes in the singular number, sometimes in the plural.
To which verse is similar the verse that is read with the lemma Αἰσχύλου [of Aeschylus] in Stobaeus Flor. 20, 13 ὀργῆς ματαίας εἰσὶν ἰατροὶ λόγου [of vain anger words are healers].
Thus Elmsl. for λόγους [words].
where εὐχαῖς [prayers] and λόγοις [words] are opposed to each other, which Hermann had not noticed when he conjectured εὐλόγως [reasonably].
where Hermann has ἄλλαν δ᾽ ἔστιν ἐν λόγοις στυγεῖν [but it is possible to hate another in words].
About a fabulous narrative.
ἀκού-σει μύθον ἐν βραχεῖ λόγῳ [he will hear a tale in brief speech] from the apograph for χρόνῳ [time].
πρὸς λόγον τοῦ σήματος [in proportion to the sign].
in plain speech
such things as I explain in my words
but if you hurl such harsh and sharpened words
when anger is sick (I corrected Ζεούσης [seething]) words are healers
clearly your word sends me back home
as I was rushing on, you shouted this word at me
may I not offend in words
not weaving riddles, but in plain speech
in plain speech I hate all the gods
for I say that the most shameful disease is composite words
I never boasted that foreign words would come to my hearing
cast my words into your heart
for the words you have now heard
and do not dishonor my word
I will leave out the greater part of the crowd of words
coming to the same track of ancient words
but turbid words strike at random against the waves of hateful ruin
if you are not persuaded by my words
hating arrogant words
the word reaches through my breast
you will not blunt me, sharpened as I am, with your word
I am driven mad by fear of the word
the messenger's word is clear
neither to frighten too much with words nor to encourage
where do you turn the end of your words?
but do you kindly soothe him with words
and to hear these words
to toil in exchange for a word
but I reject the opposite word to these
having been taught, I will master this word
being defeated by words, I do not refuse
I appeared to be wandering with such words
he spoke a word to you as you were learning
I persuade him with a word
indeed, speaking to you, she ceases with a clear word
but if you are without understanding and do not accept the word
the word does not cheer me
but no healer presides over this word
I am at a loss with words to raise the dead again
you who boast such a word over a man
thus stands the word of a woman
I will speak, since you command, the word from my heart
having honored this word
and indeed they stretched out this blameless word
he makes words blind
for in a messenger a hidden word is set straight
I will obey these words of yours
these gods I invoke in prayers; but Pallas Pronaia is honored in words
I extended such a length of speech
but Cypris is cast aside unhonored by this word
do not cut short my honors with a word
you spit out words
half a word (thus from the apograph for λόγου [of a word]) is present
if someone should speak a clear word
you boast this word over one not yet laid low
by your word
I will show you a proof of this word
you will praise this word
but someone will know words in length
Zeus will not be entangled in unjust words
and do not become a drag in word
